title: Quantum-Assisted Battery Electrolyte Synthesis
abstract: We propose a novel hybrid quantum-classical variational eigensolver approach to simulate transition states in fluorinated solid-state electrolytes. Preliminary density functional theory shows extreme non-linear ionic conductivity at low temperatures, with high variance across cathode interfaces. Requires deep empirical validation in dry-room testbeds to confirm structural stability against dendrite penetration.
recommended_triage_stream: Deep Review Queue (High VOI Boundary Case)

title: Enterprise Customer Support AI Wrapper
abstract: An automated prompt-chaining integration layer that connects GPT-4 to existing Zendesk and Salesforce ticketing databases. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with vector search over corporate PDFs. Demonstrates 15% faster ticket resolution on routine inquiries with predictable incremental performance.

title: Non-Canonical Amino Acid Biosensor for Pesticide Runoff
abstract: Engineered cell-free expression platforms incorporating synthetic pyrrolysyl-tRNA synthetase variants to detect sub-nanomolar agricultural pesticide runoff. The reaction kinetics exhibit ambiguous initial luminescence curves near the detection boundary. Deep enzyme sequencing and HPLC verification are required to resolve false-positive binding.
recommended_triage_stream: Deep Review Queue (Optimal for VOI Allocation)

title: Decentralized Autonomous Grant Voting Protocol
abstract: A zero-knowledge quadratic funding smart contract on Ethereum L2 that leverages decentralized token staking and AI reputation heuristics to auto-curate open source public goods. The whitepaper contains generated boilerplates with unverified game-theoretic convergence assumptions.
